definitions.gloss: person in need; the destitute; the needy
definitions.explanation: A person suffering from severe poverty or hardship. A formal term used in social welfare, government policy, and news reporting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧{困窮者|こんきゅうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧。
examples.english: To support people in financial need.

examples.japanese: {困窮者|こんきゅうしゃ}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}→相談窓口：23532_soudanmadoguchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A consultation counter for people in need was set up.

examples.japanese: ⟦コロナ{禍|か}→コロナ禍：29315_koronaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧{困窮者|こんきゅうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急増|きゅうぞう}→急増：12671_kyuuzou⟧し、⟦{自治体|じちたい}→自治体：13946_jichitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われた→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: The COVID pandemic caused a sharp increase in people in financial need, and local governments struggled to respond.

notes: Most commonly appears in the compound ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧{困窮者|こんきゅうしゃ} (person in financial hardship), which is the official term used in Japanese welfare law (⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧{困窮者|こんきゅうしゃ}⟦{自立|じりつ}→自立：13970_jiritsu⟧{支援法|しえんほう} — the Act on Self-Reliance Support for Needy Persons). The suffix ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ marks this as a formal, categorical label for a type of person, making it appropriate for policy and news contexts rather than everyday conversation.
